paragraphs: QQQ is +0.46% versus the prior close. The Nasdaq Score is -29/100 (Cautiously Negative). Score path: pre-market -48 → now -29.

The main live drivers are Semiconductors are supportive: Live · SOX +1.17% | Nasdaq +0.21% | SOX vs Nasdaq +0.96 pp | SOXX vs Nasdaq +1.15 pp | SMH vs Nasdaq +1.13 pp. It changed from negative to positive after the baseline snapshot. Oil is a headwind for Nasdaq: Brent $116.98 (+3.37%) | WTI $102.97 (+3.52%). The 2Y rate signal is a headwind: 4.697% (+6.2 bp vs prev close).
QQQ and its internal leadership are diverging, so the index move has weaker confirmation (semiconductors positive, mega-caps negative, breadth mixed).

What would change the view: improvement would require further easing in the 10Y toward/below 4.95%, broader participation. Deterioration would be reinforced by a renewed 10Y break above roughly 5.05%, semiconductor leadership rolling over, a material volatility expansion.
